scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ayko/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n core,bo,tab -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @ayko/core" "npm run dev -w @ayko/backoffice" "npm run dev -w @ayko/display"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build -w @ayko/contracts && cross-env AYKO_MOCK=true concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n core,bo,tab -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @ayko/core" "npm run dev -w @ayko/backoffice" "npm run dev -w @ayko/display"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ayko/contracts && npm run build -w @ayko/core && npm run build -w @ayko/backoffice && npm run build -w @ayko/display
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ayko/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
